title: add-electron-desktop-rag-authoring-kit-local-runner-and-telemetry-stubs
author: Camila Ruiz
release_notes: Adds an Electron-based local RAG authoring app and a guided quickstart. No breaking changes.
description: Motivation: provide a local-first, offline-capable RAG authoring desktop for developers and content creators, to prototype retrieval indices, tool-binding previews, and step-debugging without cloud credentials. This PR introduces an Electron-based authoring kit, a compact Node local-runner that mirrors Redwood runtime tool-calling semantics, a devcontainer for consistent local setup, example SQLite-backed index snapshots, and a docs quickstart with stepwise troubleshooting tips. Checklist: [x] scaffold electron app and renderer/main split || [x] implement local index snapshot + lightweight search adapter || [x] add local-runner that simulates streaming responses & KV cache || [x] add typesafe tool stubs & example tool bindings || [x] quickstart README + authoring tutorial || [x] e2e smoke CI + devcontainer. Commits: feat(electron): scaffold app & IPC bridge; feat(local-runner): implement runner and streaming shim; feat(index): sqlite snapshot + search adapter; docs: quickstart and authoring tutorial; test(ci): add e2e smoke and playwright checks; chore: npm workspace config and license headers. Files changed (high level): electron/ (scaffold, IPC bridge), packages/local-runner/ (runner, dev helper), examples/authoring-templates/ (index snapshots, example tools), docs/quickstarts/electron-rag-authoring.md (quickstart), .github/workflows/e2e-smoke.yml (CI), devcontainer.json, package.json (workspace updates), .gitattributes (index handling). Review conversation: Daniel Park: "Can we avoid shipping large index files in the repo?" Author (Camila): "Indexes are small (<=2MB) sample snapshots and marked in .gitattributes; also added guidance to recreate them via the local-runner. We can switch to downloadable fixtures if needed." Aisha Malik: "Local-runner should expose the same auth patterns as hosted API for parity." Author: "Added a config shim and example tokens; documented in quickstart and flagged follow-up for secure packaging." Ben Porter: "CI flakes on macOS electron build; test times out sometimes." Author: "Switched to headless electron build in CI, increased Playwright timeouts and added a flaky-test retry hook; reran CI and confirmed stability." CI summary: initial run -> build: pass, lint: pass, e2e: fail (Playwright timeout on macOS matrix) -> fix committed -> rerun -> all checks pass. Merge: merged via squash on 2026-03-08 by Camila Ruiz. Notes: This is an examples/docs addition intended as a lightweight dev kit and local authoring UX; it is not a production-backed runtime. Follow-up work: ENG-2345 to track packaging as a standalone binary and installer, PM-9087 to add telemetry opt-in UX and usage analytics guidance. Troubleshooting: quickstart includes common electron dev pitfalls, local-runner debug flags, and steps to recreate index snapshots. Test instructions: npm install && npm run build:workspace && npm run dev:electron (or use devcontainer).
notes: Small sample indexes are intentionally committed; see docs for regeneration script. E2E CI added to protect regressions.
